title: Zeely approved production scene release manifest

framingLock.$comment: GENERATED by tools/generate-framing-lock-schema.mjs from sceneFramingLock() in src/web/scene-contract.js. Do not hand-edit: run the script. evidenceRows selects a lock row by the three numbers the receipt declares; passingEvidenceRows adds the measurements that row makes passable; the allOf branches pin the declared row to the preset the scene was shot under.

allOf.comment: A crop must state its cost. Without this a cropping delivery could record the strategy and omit how much of the provider frame it discarded.

geometry_strategy.comment: blurred_canvas_contain_no_subject_crop is no longer produced — padding a frame onto a blurred stretch of itself faked the delivery size. It stays listed so receipts written before that path was removed still validate.
